details.prompt_en: This illustration is composed from the scripture action: Jesus came to Nazareth, entered the synagogue on the Sabbath, and stood up to read. In the mid-ground, a solitary figure stands upright beside a wooden reading stand, unrolling a long parchment scroll with both hands. No text or letters appear on the scroll; it is a blank unrolled shape. Soft side light enters from a high window, casting gentle shadows across warm stone. The palette is muted warm gray and ochre, with touches of olive green in the robes and a faint cool shadow. The scene is quiet, paper-like flat illustration, not photorealistic or cinematic. No modern clothing, no modern objects. The congregation remains anonymous and distant, reinforcing the solemnity of the Sabbath reading. The scroll’s shape and the standing posture are the key visual motifs. Atmosphere: reverent, still, early morning light. Avoid any halo or glowing divine figure; keep Jesus as a distant robed silhouette with face turned away or obscured by shadow.
